name: Muzeul Antipa

sources.label: OSM w23610985 · museum footprint (live 2026-11-12 per the source comment); no height or levels tagged
Antipa museum added as a landmark (9282891)

improvements: The Grigore Antipa museum is a landmark on its mapped footprint: two tall storeys under a cornice, a raised central pavilion with a pediment and an engaged-column porch on the Sos. Kiseleff (east) front. It replaces a generic 5.8 m building.
remainingGaps: Cornice height (13.5 m), pavilion height (18.5 m), bay spacing, window sizes and the porch order are estimates: OSM gives no height or levels. The look comes from a street-level view used as reference only.
Roof form is a flat grey cap; the real roofscape was not surveyed.
Isolated model studies; placement, floodlighting at night and neighbours in the Romana district were not captured for this record.
